description: Raises `point`'s maxLength from 300 to 420. Production evidence: a real ~56-scene episode's final beat -- the recap/payoff, which legitimately has more to tie together than an ordinary scene -- hit the 300-char cap on all 3 attempts, blocking the run outright with no repair path (unlike additionalProperties or enum near-misses, an over-length string has no deterministic auto-fix). 300 was never derived from an actual content budget; raising it gives complex terminal beats real headroom while the prompt still asks for a compact `action=...; prop=...; function=...; value=...` structure. Additive per RFC 0007: any 1.5.0 script (point <=300 chars) remains valid under 1.6.0's wider bound.

point.description: What this beat does for the story.

speaker.description: character_id from the run's cast_roster who speaks this line. Absent for single-narrator scripts.

emotion.description: The speaker's emotional delivery for this line - drives the cartoon renderer's expression/pose choice, and is the visual planner's default speaker_emotion for this scene unless the direction genuinely needs a different nuance. Only meaningful alongside "speaker".
